policy: All database tables must be classified. User/tenant business data is RLS-required. Framework/global/service-only tables require an explicit exemption reason and must not be directly exposed to untrusted clients.

exempt.plans: global catalog, server-managed; public reads are filtered by active flag
exempt.music_styles: global music catalog, server-managed; client reads are filtered by active flag
exempt.occasions: global occasion catalog, server-managed; client reads are filtered by active flag
exempt.occasion_fields: per-occasion personalisation field catalog (labels, types, options), server-managed; client reads are filtered by active flag and never include ai_hint, which is only read server-side to build the lyrics prompt; answers are re-validated server-side against these definitions
exempt.ui_translations: global UI-text translation overlay (French source text → en/es/pt), server-managed by the admin 'Actualiser les traductions' action; contains no user data; read publicly through /api/i18n/overlay
exempt.moods: global mood (ambiance) catalog, server-managed; client reads are filtered by active flag; ai_hint is only read server-side to build the Musicful prompt
exempt.phone_prefixes: global phone-prefix catalog, server-managed; client reads are filtered by active flag
exempt.recipient_relations: global recipient-relation catalog, server-managed; client reads are filtered by active flag
exempt.coupons: global promo-code catalog, server-managed; validated and applied server-side only (app/api/payments/coupons/apply, app/api/payments/checkout) — never exposes redemption counts or other coupons' existence to clients
exempt.languages: global language catalog, server-managed; client reads are filtered independently by interface and lyrics activation flags
exempt.language_accents: global admin-managed vocal accent variants of a lyrics language (e.g. Ivorian French), server-managed; ai_hint is only read server-side to build the Musicful prompt (lib/languages/accents-server.ts) and is never exposed to clients
exempt.music_style_accents: global admin-managed link between a music style and a language accent, server-managed; never queried by clients
exempt.localization_settings: global server-managed localization configuration; contains no user data and is never queried directly by clients
exempt.country_languages: global admin-managed country-to-language mapping, server-managed; used server-side only by automatic language detection (lib/languages/detection.ts)
exempt.library_collections: global editorial catalog, server-managed; client reads are restricted to active public collections
exempt.payment_fulfillments: server-only idempotency ledger; never client queried
exempt.funnel_events: server-only product funnel telemetry (see lib/analytics/funnel.ts); written and read exclusively via getServiceDb(), never queried directly by clients; purged after 180 days by app/api/cron/funnel-retention/route.ts
exempt.payment_bypass_settings: server/admin-only global toggle; contains no user data and is never queried directly by clients
exempt.playback_settings: server/admin-only global single-row setting (exclusive song playback on/off); contains no user data and is only read/written server-side via lib/settings/playback.ts and app/admin/settings/actions.ts
exempt.ambient_background_track: server/admin-only global single-row setting (dashboard ambient music track); contains no user data and is only read/written server-side via lib/settings/ambient-track.ts
exempt.mobile_store_links: server/admin-only global single-row setting (Google Play / App Store URLs); contains no user data and is only read/written server-side via lib/settings/store-links.ts
exempt.trending_settings: server/admin-only global single-row setting (dashboard "Tendances" widget mode/pool); contains no user data and is only read/written server-side via lib/trending/settings.ts and lib/trending/admin.ts
exempt.hero_animated_texts: global landing Hero catalog, server-managed; client reads are filtered by active flag (lib/hero-animated-texts/server.ts), mutations restricted to admin Server Actions (app/admin/animated-texts/actions.ts)
exempt.hero_animation_settings: server/admin-only global single-row setting (landing Hero headline/animation type/text size); contains no user data and is only read/written server-side via lib/hero-animation/settings.ts and app/admin/animated-texts/actions.ts
exempt.landing_song_features: server/admin-only global curation table (which published songs appear in the landing "Ils ont créé avec MusikPro"/"Bibliothèque populaire" sections); contains no user data, only references already-public song_publications rows, and is only read/written server-side via lib/landing-features/server.ts, lib/landing-features/admin.ts and app/admin/landing-features/actions.ts
exempt.discover_settings: server/admin-only global single-row setting (client Découvrir page display options); contains no user data and is only read/written server-side via lib/discover/server.ts and app/admin/library/actions.ts
exempt.discover_hidden_songs: server-only moderation ledger (song groups removed from Découvrir by their owner or the team); references song groups only, never queried directly by clients, read/written via lib/discover/server.ts
exempt.currencies: server/admin-only global catalog of display currencies and exchange rates; contains no user data and is only read/written server-side via lib/credit-plans/currencies-server.ts and app/admin/languages/currency-actions.ts
exempt.currency_settings: server/admin-only global single-row setting (exchange-rate service and last refresh); contains no user data and is only read/written server-side via app/admin/languages/currency-actions.ts
exempt.custom_role: server/admin-only global role catalog; created/edited/deleted exclusively via Super-Admin-gated Server Actions (app/admin/roles/actions.ts), never queried directly by clients
exempt.ai_provider_configs: server/admin-only global configuration containing an encrypted provider credential
exempt.audio_provider_configs: server/admin-only global configuration containing an encrypted provider credential
exempt.push_devices: user-owned push token registry (Firebase); never queried directly by clients — always accessed server-side via getServiceDb() in lib/notifications/devices.ts with explicit user_id checks, not direct RLS
exempt.notification_preferences: user-owned notification preferences; never queried directly by clients — always accessed server-side via getServiceDb() with an explicit user_id filter in lib/notifications/devices.ts, not direct RLS
exempt.user_notifications: user-owned notification ledger; never queried directly by clients — always accessed server-side via getServiceDb() with an explicit user_id filter in lib/notifications/server.ts, not direct RLS
exempt.creation_drafts: user-owned song-creation draft (one per user, expires 30 days after the last save); never queried directly by clients — always accessed server-side via getServiceDb() with an explicit user_id filter in lib/creation-draft/server.ts, not direct RLS
exempt.music_generation_jobs: user-owned generation ledger; never queried directly by clients — always accessed server-side via getServiceDb() with an explicit user_id filter (same pattern as app/api/payments/checkout/route.ts), not direct RLS
exempt.song_publications: user-owned publication ledger; never queried directly by clients — always accessed server-side via lib/ai/songs.ts, filtered by user_id for owner mutations (publishSongGroup, setSongGroupCover) and intentionally by slug alone for the anonymous public read path (getPublicSongBySlug, consumed by GET /s/[slug]), not direct RLS
exempt.user: Better Auth framework-owned table; enforce authorization through Better Auth
exempt.session: Better Auth framework-owned table; framework/session server access only
exempt.account: Better Auth framework-owned credential table; server access only
exempt.verification: Better Auth framework-owned verification table; server access only
exempt.team_member: Better Auth framework-owned team membership table
exempt.two_factor: Better Auth framework-owned 2FA secret table; server access only

conditional.Client: userId owner-scoped CRM data; Prisma transactions must set app.current_user_id before access. Required when the optional CRUD Clients migration is applied.
